Compensation decisions draw on more data than ever, and that data is scattered across surveys, spreadsheets, and tools. Pave has built the place where it all comes together: one platform, powered by real-time intelligence and open to every source compensation teams trust. Today's strategic alliance with Levels.fyi is the latest step in that effort.


[Pave](https://www.pave.com/) , the Agentic Compensation Management platform, today announced a strategic alliance with[Levels.fyi](https://www.levels.fyi/) , a compensation data platform that shows what work pays by company, level, location, and skill.


The alliance builds on Pave's partnerships with The Croner Company, Korn Ferry, WTW, and others and reflects a continuing commitment: making it easier for customers to bring the critical data behind their pay decisions into one place. Pave will continue to expand the network of data partners available on the platform, so that compensation teams don't have to stitch together sources by hand or choose between the ones they trust.


Through this strategic alliance, Pave customers can now access Levels.fyi data inside Pave Agent as well as Pave's Market Pricing tool to compare pay for a role across sources, benchmark against real-time Market Data, and price jobs and build competitive pay ranges. Customers can analyze Levels.fyi data alongside their own compensation data and any other data sources they choose to use. Pave Agent can use Levels.fyi data as a reference input to deliver compensation intelligence, so teams can ask a question in plain language and see the answer across Levels.fyi, their other sources, and real-time intelligence from 9,000-plus companies in Pave's dataset.


Levels.fyi adds a distinct lens on the market. Its data is contributed directly by the people earning it and backed by proof documents such as offer letters, W-2s, and pay stubs. Alongside survey and real-time views, it shows compensation teams what talent is actually earning.


With Levels.fyi data in Pave, mutual clients can:


- Ask Pave Agent to compare pay for a role across Levels.fyi, WTW, Korn Ferry, Croner, and Pave's real-time Market Data, all within one platform
- See self-reported Levels.fyi data next to survey and real-time benchmarks to understand where the market views agree and where they diverge
- Analyze Levels.fyi data alongside their own compensation data to see where their pay stands
- Give every analyst on the comp team, not just the person who manages the survey license, direct access to Levels.fyi data in their daily workflow


"Compensation decisions are only as good as the data behind them, and no single source tells the whole story," said Matt Schulman, CEO of Pave. "Our goal is for Pave to be the central source for the data compensation teams use to make decisions, with real-time intelligence from 9,000-plus companies as the foundation and every source a client trusts available alongside it. Croner, Korn Ferry, WTW, and now Levels.fyi are steps in that effort, and we will keep adding more. Clients shouldn't have to choose between the data sources they trust. They should have them all in one place."


"Effective compensation benchmarking starts with a simple question, 'How do we compare with the companies we actually compete against?'" said Zuhayeer Musa, co-founder of Levels.fyi. "Our data gives customers a current, company-level view of the market, backed by real proof such as offer letters and pay stubs. Bringing that perspective into Pave means teams can build the peer groups that matter to them, focus on a single competitor, and combine Levels.fyi's rich intelligence with the rest of their stack. Pave has set the standard for connected compensation, and we're excited to keep helping our mutual customers make faster, more confident pay decisions."


Levels.fyi data is now available to mutual customers through Pave Agent and Pave's Market Pricing tool. Existing customers can contact their account teams for access and availability details.

**About Pave**


Pave is the Agentic Compensation Management platform, powered by real-time compensation intelligence from 9,000-plus companies and a growing network of data partners. Beyond Market Pricing, Pave's platform spans Market Data benchmarking, Compensation Planning, Total Rewards, Team View, Visual Offer Letters, and Pave Agent, giving compensation teams one connected system to price roles, plan cycles, and communicate pay across the business. To learn more, visit[www.pave.com](https://www.pave.com/) .


**About Levels.fyi**


Levels.fyi is a compensation data platform that shows what work pays by company, level, location, and skill, and offers a different perspective of the market. Its data is contributed directly by the people earning it, backed by proof documents like offer letters, W-2s, and pay stubs. Levels.fyi reports 1M+ compensation data points, 2,100+ companies with fresh data, and 8,500+ company job ladders mapped, and says more than 3M professionals use the platform every month. To learn more, visit[www.levels.fyi](https://www.levels.fyi/) .
